properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMWOYO Omutukuvu,
Omugabi w'obulamu;
Jjangu,tukwegayiridde,
Jjangu-,okke mu myoyo gyaffe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tutegeeze ffe bwe tuli,
Tunakuwalire-ebibi:
Tutegeeze Yesu bw'ali,
Tumwebaze-obulokozi.

verse.name: v3
v4
verse.lines:
Eddagala bwe likaawa,
akambe ko bwe kasala,
Twesiga-,Omusawo waffe;
Endwadde yaffe-etuyinze.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Kale,omuliro gujje,
Gummalemu-amasengere,
-Amalala,-ettima,ne byonna
Ebitasiimibwa Yesu.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Tujjuze-amaanyi n'ekisa,
-Emirembe n'okusanyuka
N'okwewombeeka,twagale
Bannaffe okukira ffe.
